observations: PRED-683.D1 says the October 3, 2015 Blogspot posting is the earliest public-access version of The Secret Book of Walt; PRED-985.D1 says the text first appeared in Pearl and Other Poems (2014). Apparent contradiction on the work's first appearance, recorded and not reconciled (683.D1 speaks inside the book's fictional frame, which also has the post predating the golden tickets 'by decades').

PRED-744.E1 is registered 2026-05-19 (its first Zenodo deposit), while its headnote dates the text to Mind Control Poems, March 14, 2015, and to Pearl and Other Poems (2014), and its window reads '(c) 2014'. The registration date is the deposit's, not the composition's; the same plan was already stated in PRED-1099.E1 (registered 2014-05-07), so the merged claim registers at 1099.E1.
PRED-1657.F4 applies the dark-matter test of #1631 §4; it belongs with whichever claim registers #1631 §4's dark-matter definition, which is not in this batch.

PRED-1625.B1 and PRED-1631.G9 share one experiment: #1631 §25.5 states that if inscribed bodies circulate rather than exit, particular and universal inscription stop differing in kind, and says 'One experiment governs both papers.'
